info.title: autoseed: seed and inspect an EF Core model.
info.description: Command-line tool for EFCore.AutoSeed: prints the seeding plan for a DbContext without writing anything.

options.name: --context
options.description: <string>  Full name of the DbContext type to load. Required.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: <path>    Path to the assembly (.dll) containing the DbContext. Required.

options.name: --shape
options.description: <path>    Path to a shape file written by 'autoseed capture'. Required.

options.name: --seed
options.description: <long>    Seed every generated value derives from. Default: 42.

options.name: --scale
options.description:
<int>     Row count for the largest captured table, and for any table the
shape did not capture. Default: 1000.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this message.
--assembly must point at a 'dotnet publish' output (or an executable project's build
output). A plain 'dotnet build' output of a class library does not copy its NuGet package
dependencies locally, so the DbContext will fail to load.

options.name: --context

options.name: --assembly

options.name: --output
